decisions.decision: Chair scheduled the Board of Assessors, the new DPW Director and the Superintendent of Schools to present to the committee at the pre-budget season workshop.
decisions.quote: mr. watters has scheduled the board of assessors, new dpw director, and the superintendent of schools to come before the committee

decisions.decision: Finance Committee to make a recommendation on the special town meeting articles at its next meeting, which is a public hearing.
decisions.quote: the finance committee will need to make a recommendation on the articles at the next finance committee meeting, which will be a public hearing

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Town Manager reported two outstanding bills, both described as of nominal amounts; no figure printed.
budget_items.quote: ms. lemieux reported there are two outstanding bills of nominal amounts.

budget_items.topic: Article A, FY2023 budget amendments and APDC/assessor funding
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Town Manager has no full assessment of amendments; APDC requested operational funds and the assessor's cyclical inspections will need funds, pending new growth numbers.
budget_items.quote: the apdc has requested funds for an operational budget, and funds will be needed for the cyclical inspections for the assessor's office.

budget_items.topic: Article C, police collective bargaining agreement
budget_items.what_was_recorded: A Memorandum of Agreement was signed with the police union; no dollar amount is known.
budget_items.quote: a memorandum of agreement has been signed with the police union, and there is no dollar amount known at this time

budget_items.topic: Article E, reserve and on-call retirement credit
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Financial impact of the retirement credit article is unknown.
budget_items.quote: ms. lemieux commented that it is unknown whether this article will have a financial impact.

budget_items.topic: Articles G and H, sewer reserve and I/I stabilization funds
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Standard articles moving money received in the prior fiscal year into stabilization funds; no figure printed.
budget_items.quote: standard sewer article (money rec'd in prior fiscal year to be deposited in the stabilization fund

budget_items.topic: Article I, Primary School HVAC project
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Dollar amount unknown; Free Cash could be a funding source but is not certified and is typically not appropriated at a Fall Town Meeting.
budget_items.quote: free cash could be a funding source, but has not been certified, and is typically not appropriated at a fall town meeting, according to ms. brochu.

budget_items.topic: Article L, Ritter Building storm windows
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Member asked whether the town knows the cost of new windows, current heating costs, or potential savings; none are recorded as known.
budget_items.quote: mr. beardmore asked if the town knows the cost of new windows, or what heating costs are, or what could be saved with new windows.
